text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What is this, even?! This mountain of 
cardboard boxes! There's barely anywhere 
to stand?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... excuse me. This month's fan letters 
just arrived. I'll clean them up as soon 
as I finish reading.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There's no room on the floor, but my desk 
and bed are totally free. Feel free to 
dump your stuff there, kay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So please let me read just 10 more 
letters. It's not often I get a block of 
free time like this.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Even though you must've received hundreds 
of fan letters by now... You mean to say 
you read every single one of 'em?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hm? Senpai, aren't you gonna sit down?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I've decided to change my plans, 
actually.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go do some running for a while, 
so take your time readin' it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Don't mind if I do, then. I think 
I'll read just a little bit more.
